'''Dacr Vrolm''' was a member of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that operated during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Brotherhood were hired to steal a cargo of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] that a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] were transporting to the [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] [[House D'Vails]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. Vrolm obtained details of when and where the agents were to arrive on Druckenwell, and the pirate sent the Brotherhood member [[Lan Crish]] to apprehend them.
